patterns.note: Hero section uses a horizontal split layout with a solid color block on the left and a full-bleed image on the right.
Content sections are visually segmented by alternating full-width background colors (red, white, black).
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy against smaller, regular-weight body text.
A high-contrast palette of vibrant red, stark black, and clean white is used for backgrounds and key elements.
A cookie consent banner remains fixed at the bottom of the viewport across all scroll depths.
Complex processes are illustrated using large, simple, flat red iconography (house, arrows, dollar signs) within white background sections.

technique_notes: The hero section is constructed with a two-column layout where one column features a solid background color for prominent text display, and the adjacent column contains a full-height, full-width image.
Visual separation between major content blocks is achieved by applying distinct, full-width background colors (red, white, black) to each section, creating a clear rhythm as the user scrolls.
A persistent cookie consent banner is fixed to the bottom of the viewport, maintaining visibility regardless of scroll position.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (e.g., hero text is very large) contrast with smaller, regular-weight body text; some labels are small and uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements, cards, and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally balanced spacing with an airy hero section; content blocks have comfortable padding, while the footer is more dense with legal text.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and unapologetic use of a single, high-impact accent color (red) for large background blocks and calls to action. This strong color blocking, combined with sharp typography and minimalist iconography, creates an energetic and direct visual language that immediately grabs attention and clearly segments content.
